WITH equipamentos_tratados AS (
        SELECT
            FileName,
            EndID,
            Operator,
            Technology,
            EquipmentType AS EquipmentTypeOriginal,
            Model,
            Azimuth,
            HeightInstall,
            Quantity,
            AEV,
            TotalAEV,

            CASE
                WHEN
                    STRPOS(
                        UPPER(
                            COALESCE(
                                CAST(Model AS STRING),
                                ''
                            )
                        ),
                        'DIPLEX'
                    ) > 0
                    OR
                    STRPOS(
                        UPPER(
                            COALESCE(
                                CAST(Model AS STRING),
                                ''
                            )
                        ),
                        'TRIPLEX'
                    ) > 0
                THEN 'DIPLEXER'
                
                WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(Model AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    r'(^|[^A-Z0-9])ODU([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
                )
                THEN 'ODU'

                WHEN STRPOS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(Model AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    'RRU'
                ) > 0
                THEN 'RRU'

                WHEN STRPOS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(Model AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    'MW'
                ) > 0
                THEN 'TX'

                WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(Model AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    r'(^|[^A-Z0-9])TX([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
                )
                THEN 'TX'

                WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(Model AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    r'(^|[^A-Z0-9])RF([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
                )
                THEN 'RF'

                WHEN STRPOS(
                    UPPER(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(EquipmentType AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    ),
                    'MW'
                ) > 0
                THEN 'TX'

                ELSE UPPER(
                    TRIM(
                        COALESCE(
                            CAST(EquipmentType AS STRING),
                            ''
                        )
                    )
                )
            END AS EquipmentTypeTratado

        FROM `projeto-teste.dataset_teste.VW_AEV_TSSR_Equipamentos_Comp`

        WHERE UPPER(
            TRIM(
                CAST(FileName AS STRING)
            )
        ) = UPPER(
            TRIM(@file_name)
        )
    )

    SELECT
        FileName,
        EndID,
        Operator,
        Technology,
        EquipmentTypeOriginal,
        EquipmentTypeTratado,
        Model,
        Azimuth,
        HeightInstall,
        Quantity,
        AEV,
        TotalAEV,

        CASE
            WHEN EquipmentTypeTratado = 'RRU'
            THEN 'RRU'

            WHEN EquipmentTypeTratado = 'RF'
            THEN 'RF'

            WHEN EquipmentTypeTratado = 'TX'
            THEN 'TX'

            ELSE 'OUTROS'
        END AS GrupoEquipamento

    FROM equipamentos_tratados

    ORDER BY
        GrupoEquipamento,
        Operator,
        Technology,
        EquipmentTypeTratado,
        Model,
        Azimuth,
        HeightInstall
